ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. Section 10 currently ends access and returns Deliverables but says nothing about getting our data back or migration help (and Section 16.5 cross-refers to a non-existent Section 11), so we cannot exit without this. If six months is difficult, we can accept ninety days of assistance with the same thirty-day data export.
input.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, Customer Data return in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion.
